messages:
jane: Heads-up — onboarding for RippleHealth showing 429 spike right after ephemeral rotate. Attaching trace + init pattern.
jane: trace:
```
2026-03-23T07:22:10Z WARN  preflight validate status=429 path=/v1/preflight/validate
2026-03-23T07:22:11Z ERROR request failed status=429 path=/v1/chat/completions client=ripple-qa
2026-03-23T07:22:11Z WARN  concurrent token requests=88 origin=mobile-ci-eu
```
jane: their flow: mobile app CI spins up 80 workers for end-to-end tests that all fetch ephemeral directly from our /tokens/ephemeral then immediately call chat. They're on mobile-sdk v0.5.2.
liam: ops-bot shows anomaly :ops-bot:
ops-bot: [alert] rate_limit_spike account=ripplehealth region=eu window=00:00:08 peak_rps=195 baseline_rps=12 id=rl-20260323-09
liam: quick mitigation advice: 1) ask them to gate ephemeral fetch behind a tiny server-side broker OR add local in-process token cache for 2s; 2) implement client-side jittered backoff + cap parallel inits to ~10; 3) we can open a short 120s elevated window while they patch.
maria: i'll take customer comms. jane can you paste their init snippet and confirm browser vs mobile?
jane: snippet (from their CI):
```js
// each worker does
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.EPH_KEY })
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-lite', messages: [...] })
```
jane: they fetch ephemeral on-device from our endpoint, no broker.
maria: sent: "We see a short-lived fanout at rotation. Recommended immediate steps: (A) use a small server-side token broker to exchange LL key for ephemeral and cache identical requests for 1-2s, or (B) add a local in-process token cache + concurrency cap in tests. We'll open a 2-minute priority window to let inflight requests succeed." link: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboard/token-broker-pattern
liam: infra note: enable preflight coalescing for account=ripplehealth when concurrent preflight > 50 in 10s. Add rule id rl-20260323-09:coalesce for 120s. Expect fewer 429s but watch tail latency.
jane: suggested local backoff patch (sent to customer):
```py
# limit concurrency + exponential jitter
sem = asyncio.Semaphore(8)
async def safe_init():
  async with sem:
    for i in range(5):
      try:
        return await client.init()
      except HTTP429:
        await asyncio.sleep((2**i)*0.1 + random.random()*0.2)
```
maria: customer replied: "we can add broker for CI, but mobile team wants guidance for in-device tests." asked for a one-paragraph note we can include in renewal pack.
liam: please create a short renewal blurb: recommended rotation strategy + suggested concurrency limits + link to playbook. I'll mark infra change and keep window for 120s.
jane: after they applied local cache + 8-concurrency cap in CI, 429s dropped 93% in under 90s. Customer wants the one-paragraph and a small how-to for mobile test harnesses.
maria: i'll draft the one-paragraph and a 1-page mobile test appendix. posting when ready, then close after 24h stable. :thumbsup:
